text: Not sure if I'm overreacting. I'm a childminder, have a 3 yo boy here overnight. He's got chickenpox, very itchy but otherwise ok. Temp was 39.4 which seemed high to me? Also earlier he banged his head on the table, cried straight away, and I think he's totally back to normal now, running about and asking for snacks like nothing happened. Just wanted to check really, maybe it's all fine
